retrieved_sources.title: PipelineHub Family Pods & Preflight - Provisioning Subscription for TestRunner
retrieved_sources.text:
Two ways on how FDI is deployed on a BusinessApp Pod

Method 1 - Whitelist Pod for TestRunner (Post-Provisioning)

* 2 steps Process and support for ARM/x86, EXA/ManagedDatabase, support for S,M,L size only.

Method 2 - Use Marketing SKU in mock subscription which include TestRunner (As Part of Provisioning)

* 1 step Process and support for x86+EXA only, support for S size only

 | Subscription Name | Description | User Usage | 

1 | 
ALL_HYBRIDS_NO_TESTRUNNER_NO_CDP (All hybrids+FS SKU+CPQ SKU)

 | 
Using this subscription, you will have the opportunity to whitelist the pod for TestRunner post provisioning.

 | 
* Note: If you need FMK/CDP, please DO NOT use this subscription

* Step 1 - Provisioning with all/selected cloudnative services 
* If you select CDP for whatever reason, CDP deployment will FAIL

* Step 2 - Select Pod Add-ons > Deploy Hybrid FDI

ReleaseEngineering To-Do: PipelineHub can enhance to orchestrate into 1-click for useability. However, do note behind-the-scene, it will still a post-provisioning process aka Method 1 use case. ETA 2/13. ( [https://issues.example.com/reference/resource-862] DEMO-018)

ReleaseEngineering To-Do: Need to support XS subscription.  [https://issues.example.com/reference/resource-863] DEMO-019. ETA 2/6
 |

retrieved_sources.text:
**PFLT_UIBUILDSERVICE_PROD_PROVISION**  is  a group name and the feature flag is **provision-uibuildservice-hybrid-only-for-prod** which should be set to True  

### Subscriptions

Users can choose from a variety of SKUs by selecting different subscriptions during the provisioning process. Please note that all of these subscriptions are mock subscriptions.  
For more information about the available SKUs, [click here](https://api.example.com/reference/resource-398).  
To learn more about Provisioning Subscription for TestRunner, see: [Provisioning Subscription for TestRunner](https://docs.example.com/doc-0137)

### FDI Hybrid

#### FDI hybrid name is displayed in PipelineHub

### Support Data Masking as post pod action

          We have support for data masking as a post pod action.Data Masking is used for hiding PII data and for masking the fields in DB according to the DM template ingested while creation of the release. This is only applicable on non prod type pods.The Pod to be used for data masking should be with a version at least 11.13.24.10.0-11000 or above.

**Note:**

* Data masking will work for the releases for which DM template is already ingested.(Ex:GA,HWM ).

**Feature not yet supported****:**

* Multiple data masking runs.

 More details on Data Making:[Data Masking in Preflight](https://docs.example.com/reference/resource-399)

retrieved_sources.text:
### Architecture Considerations (ARM64 vs X86)

* + When Provisioning a EnvironmentService POD for ARM64, please review these instructions (that will ask us to supply override parameters): 

		- [EnvironmentService POD Provisioning Instructions](https://docs.example.com/reference/resource-391)
	+ If we are provisioning a EnvironmentService POD for x86_64 (X86 is used in the release set description), then use USE_X86_ONLY freeform tag.
	+ Note- Depending on the available quota either X86 or Arm64 POD will be created.. Refer to [Specific Instructions for Arm64 pod](https://docs.example.com/reference/resource-391)
* Step 1: Provision a EnvironmentService POD based on the BusinessApp Release or the PipelineHub ID (and supply override parameters for ARM64 if you are using ARM64)

### Provisioning Additional Considerations

* Use Additional Parameters to override values
	+ Sample: lcmArtifactSetId=LifecycleManagerArtifactSet_2024.01.02.1_1.1.320_2023-12 [to override a different version of lcmArtifactsSet. This is just an example, use the value only after consulting LifecycleManager]

### Post Provisioning Action Considerations of Patch, Upgrade, Run Tests, Bounce, Backup, P2T, Resize, Scaleout, Granular SSH, Load Demo Users (DeploymentTemplate only) and Delete

* Once the POD is provisioned, future actions available on it in PipelineHub are to Patch it, Upgrade it, Run Tests on it, Bounce BusinessApp Services, Bounce BusinessApp and IDM Services on it, Load Demo User, or Delete it

### Enable RuntimeDiagnostics for EnvironmentService Provisioning

The EnvironmentService provisioning submission UI has introduced a new option for RuntimeDiagnostics enablement. This feature will enable RuntimeDiagnostics after POD provisioning is successful

Please do take a note we now support API provisioning submissions as well.

More about RuntimeDiagnostics: <https://docs.example.com/reference/resource-393>

### Allow opt-in for OPA hybrid service from UI

User to select checkbox to opt for OPA service while provisioning

### Allow opt-in for UIBuildService hybrid service for Prod from UI

User can now provision UIBuildService Hybrid for Prod and not as a Test pod using the feature flag -

**PFLT_UIBUILDSERVICE_PROD_PROVISION** is a group name and the feature flag is **provision-uibuildservice-hybrid-only-for-prod** which should be set to True

--------------------------------------------------------------------

* Search for the project name in the PipelineHub search bar
* You will be landing into the CI/CD Pipelines view
	+ 
	+ 
	+ Choose the branch for which you want to trigger a pipeline (screenshot above)
	+ Click on **Trigger Pipeline** Button
	+ Enter the reason and select **All Components** button  
	
		- Select all components, you will trigger a build against all components
	+ Click on Submit button to trigger pipeline:
